## Real Data

- [FRED: Unemployment Rate](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/UNRATE)
- [FRED: Labor Force Participation Rate](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CIVPART)
- [FRED: Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL)
- [Minneapolis Fed: Regional Economic Indicators](https://www.minneapolisfed.org/region-and-community/regional-economic-indicators), regional CPI and unemployment insurance claims data
